settings.title: Settings
settings.adminDescription: The admin bearer token is used to authenticate all admin API requests. Stored in your browser's localStorage.
settings.tokenHelp: Token is saved to localStorage and sent as a Bearer token with every admin API request.
settings.modelCatalogDescription: models.dev supplies baseline modalities, tools, reasoning, and context limits for fetched models.
settings.catalogReady: Catalog is ready. Local capability overrides always take priority.
settings.catalogStale: Using the local cached catalog; refresh when a network connection is available.
settings.ocrFallbackDescription: Give text-only models limited image understanding by extracting text from images before forwarding the request.
settings.ocrRouteHelp: Only requests containing images and routed to a model without image support are transformed. Vision-capable models continue receiving the original image.
settings.ocrProviderHelp: vibe-proxy uses its embedded engine by default. Images are only sent to an external service when you explicitly select and configure one.
settings.builtinOCRDescription: The model and WASM engine are embedded in vibe-proxy and run offline in a short-lived isolated copy of the same executable so memory is released promptly. No extra Docker service, Python, system Tesseract, or network request is required.
settings.ocrContractHelp: The service receives a small JSON image batch and returns recognized text with confidence. Image data and OCR text are never written to request telemetry.
settings.visionFallbackNone: Do not use a Vision fallback
settings.visionFallbackHelp: If OCR is unavailable or confidence is too low, preserve the original image and route to this explicitly Vision-capable model.
settings.visionFallbackEmpty: Mark at least one provider model as supporting images before selecting a Vision fallback.
settings.ocrEndpointRequired: Enter the OCR service endpoint first
settings.builtinOCRTestSucceeded: Built-in OCR succeeded in {{latency}}ms with {{confidence}}% confidence
settings.appearanceDescription: Choose the control plane theme for this browser.
settings.themeHelp: Saved locally in your browser and applied on startup.
settings.languageDescription: Choose the display language for the control plane.
settings.languageHelp: Defaults to your browser language and is saved locally after you choose.
